description: Agent runtime: stable auto-generated identity with disk persistence, the outbound-only wss client with capped backoff+jitter and single-path liveness, the event->wire bridge + inbound command execution (re-validating with the existing src/api/schemas.ts) + on-demand log forwarding, and the agent boot that dials first and wires local PM2 in the background. Reuses the existing src/pm2 layer and src/protocol from FEAT-001. Covers plan.md items 5-8. Depends on FEAT-001 (protocol, backoff, config MODE, boot dispatch). Maps to design section 3 and FR-2/FR-4 with AC-7..AC-21.
steps: Create src/agent/identity.ts: `resolveAgentId({ idFile, hostname, logger, readFile?, writeFile?, randomSuffix? }): string`. Read the suffix file -> id = `${sanitize(hostname)}-${suffix}`; missing/unreadable/empty -> generate crypto.randomBytes(4).toString('hex'), mkdir -p the dir, write best-effort, log info 'generated agent id suffix'; unwritable dir -> derive an in-memory id and log warn (non-fatal). Sanitize hostname to the processNameSchema-safe charset. Inject readFile/writeFile/randomSuffix for tests. Add src/agent/identity.test.ts (new suffix generated+persisted when file missing; same id reused when present; regeneration logs info on unreadable file; stable across simulated restarts).

Create src/agent/connection.ts: `AgentConnection` wrapping a ws WebSocket. Dial SERVER_URL (+ AGENT_WS_PATH) with { rejectUnauthorized: !insecure }; on open send register; reset the backoff attempt counter ONLY on register:ack (never on socket open); unbounded retries via the shared backoffDelay from src/core/backoff.ts; heartbeat default 15s taken from register:ack, dead-link threshold 2*heartbeatSec via both an app-level heartbeat-ack timer and a transport ping/pong backstop; a SINGLE idempotent onLinkDead() (alreadyDead guard) funnels every teardown path (register:nack [log the nack code first], 5s handshake-timeout/transport close, heartbeat/pong dead-link) -> close once + schedule exactly one reconnect at the current un-reset delay; TLS_INSECURE passes rejectUnauthorized:false AND logs a clearly-marked insecure warning at startup and on each (re)connect. Inject timers/socket factory. Add src/agent/connection.test.ts (reconnect capped backoff+jitter via injected timers; no crash when server unreachable at boot + keeps retrying; register sent on open; register:nack AUTH_FAILED -> backoff holds at 30s cap, not a hot-loop; retries unbounded so a later-accepted token eventually registers; insecure toggle passes rejectUnauthorized:false + logs the warning; onLinkDead idempotent — second trigger is a no-op).

Create src/agent/logForwarder.ts: `LogForwarder` holding the subscribed set of (process, streams); on log:subscribe add to the filter and forward matching live MonitorEvents 'log:line' events as log:line frames; on log:unsubscribe (or disconnect) drop the filter and stop. Mirrors WsHub.fanOutLog filtering; does not re-tail files.

Create src/agent/runtime.ts: `AgentRuntime` subscribing to MonitorEvents and forwarding (only while connected): snapshot on (re)connect and a throttled (<=1/sec, coalesced like WsHub state throttling) resend whenever the process NAME SET changes; update:transition on process:transition; update:metrics on metrics:tick mapping each ONLINE ProcessSnapshot to { name: snap.name, ts: snap.lastUpdated, cpu: snap.cpu, mem: snap.memory } with ts carried verbatim; update:error on error:captured; update:pm2 on pm2:connected/pm2:disconnected. Inbound control:request (start/stop/restart/reload/delete) re-validates name with processNameSchema; control:createRequest validates createProcess.safeParse({ body: opts }) built from buildSchemas({ allowedScriptRoot: config.ALLOWED_SCRIPT_ROOT }), consumes the POST-transform body (so instances>1 injects exec_mode:'cluster') passed to Pm2Client.startNew, checks path existence on the agent disk; on validation failure returns correlated control:response { cid, result: { ok:false, code:'VALIDATION', message } } and never touches PM2; on success returns the real ControlResult. AgentRuntime holds the Pm2Deps facade (not a raw Pm2Client) so a command before PM2 attaches returns correlated PM2_UNAVAILABLE. Add src/agent/runtime.test.ts and src/agent/logForwarder.test.ts (valid control -> Pm2Client called + correlated response with the ControlResult; invalid name/opts -> correlated VALIDATION, PM2 not called; createProcess { body } wrapper; instances>1 no exec_mode -> transformed cluster reaches startNew; non-existent script on the agent disk via a fake fileExists -> VALIDATION; unknown keys rejected by .strict(); log subscribe forwards matching lines, unsubscribe stops).

Create src/boot/agent.ts: `bootstrapAgent(config)` plus `buildAgentDialConfig(cfg)`. Build the core hub (MonitorEvents/MetricsStore/ErrorTracker/MonitorState exactly as index.ts) + a Pm2Deps facade (a mutable pm2Client ref that short-circuits control to PM2_UNAVAILABLE and readLogsTail to [] until the real client is assigned — identical shape to src/index.ts) + AgentRuntime + AgentConnection. START the AgentConnection dial loop first/concurrently; wire the real createPm2Adapter(logger)/new Pm2Client(...)/client.start() in a background task (void (async () => { try {...} catch { log 'pm2 wiring failed; continuing' } })()) exactly as index.ts does today, so the dial is never blocked by a hung/absent local PM2 and a control:request before PM2 attaches returns correlated PM2_UNAVAILABLE. Run NO HTTP server and open NO listening port. Install the same graceful-shutdown handlers (stop connection + pm2Client?.stop + state/errors stop).
Edit src/index.ts: the bootstrap() MODE dispatch now calls bootstrapAgent() for MODE==='agent'.

Add src/boot/agent.test.ts: using the fake pm2 client and a fake/loopback connection, assert the agent registers and heartbeats while PM2 is absent, that a control:request arriving before PM2 attaches yields a correlated PM2_UNAVAILABLE ControlResult, and that no HTTP port is opened.
acceptance_criteria: `npm test` passes all existing suites plus the new identity, connection, runtime, logForwarder, and agent-boot tests.
The agent opens only an outbound wss connection and no inbound port (AC-7); its ID is stable across restarts (AC-8/9).
The agent never crashes when the server is unreachable and retries with capped backoff+jitter, unbounded (AC-11/12); register:nack holds at the 30s cap rather than hot-looping.

Inbound commands are re-validated with src/api/schemas.ts before PM2 is touched; invalid commands return a correlated VALIDATION error and never call PM2 (AC-17/18); valid commands return the correlated ControlResult (AC-19).
A control:request before local PM2 attaches returns a correlated PM2_UNAVAILABLE and the server connection is independent of local PM2 state (AC-14).
Standalone and server boot paths remain unaffected.
findings:
Implemented and green: npm run build clean, npm test 235/235 (198 preserved + 37 new). Exact exported names/paths for later FEATs (FEAT-004 server side mirrors these):

src/agent/identity.ts: `resolveAgentId({ idFile, hostname, logger, readFile?, writeFile?, randomSuffix? }): string`. id = `${sanitize(hostname)}-${suffix}`; sanitize collapses non-[A-Za-z0-9._-] runs to '-' and trims (empty -> 'agent'). Missing/unreadable/empty suffix file -> randomBytes(4).hex, mkdir -p + write best-effort, logs info 'generated agent id suffix'; unwritable dir -> in-memory id + warn 'could not persist...'. Suffix is the only persisted datum; stable across restarts.

src/agent/connection.ts: `AgentConnection` + exported `joinUrl(base, wsPath)`, interfaces `AgentSocket` (on('open'|'message'|'close'|'error'|'pong'), send(string), ping(), close(), terminate?()), `AgentSocketFactory = (opts:{url,rejectUnauthorized}) => AgentSocket`, `AgentRegisterMeta`, `AgentConnectionOptions`, `AgentConnectionHandlers { onRegistered?({serverTime,heartbeatSec}), onDisconnected?(), onMessage?(ProtocolMessage) }`. Methods: setHandlers, isRegistered(), start(), stop(), send(msg) [drops unless registered]. Dials joinUrl(serverUrl,wsPath) via injected socketFactory with rejectUnauthorized:!insecure; sends register on 'open'; backoffAttempt resets ONLY on register:ack (never on open) via shared backoffDelay (unbounded retries, holds at 30s cap on repeated nack); heartbeatSec from ack (default 15, harness-overridable via defaultHeartbeatSec); app-level heartbeat tick emits {type:'heartbeat'} + transport ping each heartbeatSec; dead-link check at 2*heartbeatSec clears link if no heartbeat:ack/pong seen; HANDSHAKE_TIMEOUT_MS=5000 non-extendable; single idempotent onLinkDead(reason) (alreadyDead guard) funnels register:nack [logs code 'registration rejected' at warn first], transport close/error, handshake timeout, dead-link -> close once + one scheduleReconnect at current un-reset delay; insecure logs 'INSECURE: TLS certificate verification disabled' each dial. Timers/now/socketFactory injectable.

src/agent/wsSocket.ts: `createWsSocketFactory(): AgentSocketFactory` — the production factory wrapping `ws` WebSocket (sole ws-client import; no new dependency). Kept out of connection.ts so the state machine stays test-pure.

src/agent/logForwarder.ts: `LogForwarder({ events, send })` holding a process->Set<'out'|'err'> filter; subscribe(process, streams) (empty array -> both), unsubscribe(process), clear(), stop(); forwards matching MonitorEvents 'log:line' as {type:'log:line', process, stream, level, line, ts}. Mirrors WsHub.fanOutLog; no file re-tail.

src/agent/runtime.ts: `AgentRuntime(opts: AgentRuntimeOptions { events, state, pm2: Pm2Deps, schemas: RequestSchemas, logger, send, isConnected, now?, setTimer?, clearTimer? })`. Public: stop(), onRegistered() [resets name-set + sends immediate snapshot], onDisconnected() [clears log subs], handleMessage(ProtocolMessage) [dispatches control:request/control:createRequest/log:subscribe/log:unsubscribe]. control:request re-validates name via processNameSchema; control:createRequest validates schemas.createProcess.safeParse({ body: opts }) (mandatory { body } wrapper, .strict rejects unknown keys, transform injects exec_mode:'cluster' when instances>1), consumes parsed.data.body (post-transform) reconstructed into StartNewOpts exactly as src/api/routes/processes.ts; path existence checked on agent disk via the injected schemas. Validation failure -> correlated {type:'control:response',cid,result:{ok:false,code:'VALIDATION',message}} and PM2 untouched. PM2 reached ONLY through the Pm2Deps facade so pre-attach control returns PM2_UNAVAILABLE. Outbound (only while isConnected()): metrics:tick -> update:metrics mapping each ONLINE ProcessSnapshot to {name, ts:snap.lastUpdated, cpu, mem} (ts verbatim); process:transition -> update:transition; error:captured -> update:error; pm2:connected/disconnected -> update:pm2; snapshot sent on onRegistered AND whenever the process NAME SET changes, throttled/coalesced to <=1/sec (STATE_THROTTLE_MS=1000) like WsHub. sendSnapshot sets {type:'snapshot',processes,pm2Connected,generatedAt}.

src/boot/agent.ts: `bootstrapAgent(config, logger): Promise<void>` + `buildAgentDialConfig(cfg): { url, wsPath, token, nameHint?, idFile, insecure }` + exported interface `AgentDialConfig`. Builds the core hub exactly like standalone, a deferred Pm2Deps facade (mutable pm2Client ref short-circuiting to PM2_UNAVAILABLE/[]), AgentRuntime, AgentConnection(createWsSocketFactory()); START connection.start() FIRST, then wire createPm2Adapter/new Pm2Client/client.start() in a background `void (async()=>{...})()` with the same 'pm2 wiring failed; continuing' catch as index.ts. meta = { hostname: os.hostname(), platform: process.platform, monitorVersion:'1.0.0', nameHint? }. Opens NO HTTP server/port. Graceful shutdown: connection.stop + runtime.stop + pm2Client?.stop + state.stop + errors.stop. MONITOR_VERSION='1.0.0'.

src/index.ts: bootstrap() MODE dispatch now calls bootstrapAgent(config, logger) for MODE==='agent' (server branch still throws 'not yet implemented' until FEAT-004).

Fleet-code note for FEAT-004: the agent emits control:response results with codes VALIDATION / PM2_UNAVAILABLE / PM2_ERROR (the ControlResult contract). The server-side controlStatus mapper (design §4) must map VALIDATION->400, PM2_UNAVAILABLE/AGENT_OFFLINE->409, AGENT_NOT_FOUND->404, AGENT_TIMEOUT->504, else 502.
